sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) and Boston University (BU) are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership codes in the College Scorecard. CWRU is located in Cleveland and has an undergraduate enrollment of 6,437 students, while BU is situated in Boston with a larger undergraduate population of 18,248. Tuition costs for in-state students at CWRU are $66,608, slightly lower than BU's $68,102. These differences in location, enrollment size, and tuition contribute to the distinct experiences offered by each university.
